what.text: This page follows internal displacement in Albania, as recorded by IDMC.
IDMC's year-end count of people still displaced by disasters went from 32255 in 2019 to 148 in 2025.

why.text: IDMC's disaster records for Albania list floods and wildfires.
The fact pack records no armed conflict for Albania in these years.

when.text: The main year of displacement in the data is 2019.

how.text: In 2025, IDMC recorded 2895 new displacements by disasters: these count movements, not people.
The sources don't say where people went inside Albania.
